Advanced Composites and Hybrid Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in interface-engineered CoMoN/MXene hybrids with hierarchical nanosheet architecture, revealing asymmetric ion transport—faster charging in pristine CoMoN versus enhanced discharge transport in the hybrid via conductive MXene frameworks and possible K⁺ participation. Significance includes reversible CoOOH/Co(OH)₂ phase evolution, suppressed Mo dissolution, and DFT-validated migration barriers, offering mechanistic insight for designing advanced supercapattery electrodes.

پوشش پلیمری ایتاکونیک اسید به‌صورت درجا روی کاتد LiFePO4 ظرفیت و شارژ سریع را بهبود می‌بخشد و پایداری چرخه‌ای بالایی فراهم می‌کند.
Battery Energy | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in using in-situ (electro)polymerized itaconic acid as an organic coating on LiFePO4 cathodes, enabling reversible storage of two Li⁺ per monomer and boosting capacity to 227 mAh g⁻¹ beyond LFP's theoretical limit. Significantly, it enables 3C fast charging, 99.99% capacity retention, and enhanced interfacial diffusion, offering a scalable route to high-power EV batteries.
🏷 LiFePO4 cathode · itaconic acid coating · fast charging · lithium-ion battery · in-situ polymerization

item.title: Impact of the glass transition temperature on Li-ion diffusion in amorphous alloy anodes via machine learning
item.description:
این مقاله با روش‌های یادگیری ماشین اثر دمای گذار شیشه‌ای بر نفوذ یون لیتیوم در آندهای آلیاژ آمورف را بررسی می‌کند.
npj Computational Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work builds high-precision machine-learning potentials for Li–Si/Ge/Sn/Pb amorphous anodes, revealing that conventional Arrhenius extrapolation overestimates room-temperature Li diffusivity by 1–2 orders of magnitude. It identifies glass transition temperature as a key descriptor governing the transition from localized to extended Li motion, establishing a composition–local-structure–diffusion relationship and proposing composition optimization to lower Tg for improved Li transport.
🏷 amorphous alloy anode · Li-ion diffusion · glass transition temperature · machine learning · molecular dynamics

item.title: Direct Synthesis and Electrochemical Deintercalation of Mg-Intercalated Graphullerite
item.description:
سنتز تک‌کریستال‌های میلی‌متری (Mg4C60)∞ و (Mg2C60)∞ با بازده بالا و خلوص فازی امکان بررسی درون‌شوندگی و خروج الکتروشیمیایی Mg2+ در گرافولریت را فراهم کرد.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in two chemical vapor transport methods yielding millimeter-sized single crystals of (Mg4C60)∞ and (Mg2C60)∞ with near-complete conversion, overcoming prior low yield and phase impurity by spatially separating precursors. Using Mg2Si gives phase-pure (Mg4C60)∞ at 55–62% yield, enabling the first electrochemical Mg2+ intercalation/deintercalation studies and comprehensive investigation of graphullerite and graphullerene properties.

item.title: Coupling electrolyte mechanical reinforcement and interfacial stress relaxation for near-ambient sulfide all-solid-state lithium metal batteries
item.description:
با تقویت مکانیکی الکترولیت و آرامش تنش بین‌سطحی، باتری‌های تمام‌جامد لیتیوم-فلز سولفیدی در دمای نزدیک محیط بهبود می‌یابند.
Nature Communications | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in coupling a self-polymerizable thioctic acid-modified composite sulfide electrolyte, which suppresses lithium creep with high stress tolerance, with a porous carbon current collector that relaxes interfacial stress and hosts lithium in voids. This enables stable room-temperature cycling at ≤0.3 MPa and high areal loading (2.4 mAh cm−2), highlighting controlled lithium deformation and stress relaxation as key for practical all-solid-state batteries.
🏷 sulfide solid electrolyte · all-solid-state battery · lithium metal · interfacial stress · mechanical reinforcement
